# YOTU Facturas

## Description
YOTU Facturas is a construction-first business platform for estimates, invoices, PDF documents, project cost control, payments, and profitability tracking.

## Core Features
- 3-level hierarchical budgets for construction and renovation projects.
- Estimates, invoices, and PDF client documents in one workflow.
- Project-level cost, payment, and profitability tracking.
- Multi-language product with localized public pages.
- Multi-company support and professional PDF output.

## Target Audience
- Construction companies.
- Renovation and remodeling businesses.
- Contractors and teams that need structured estimates and project control.
